purpose: Philadelphia NFL Gamecast production release-gating, asset-integrity and runtime rollback contract. Metadata-only and PHI/NFL namespaced.

releaseGate.inventory: Every routed Philadelphia player/action must resolve through roster.json; supersets on disk never create runtime eligibility and the legitimate open 53rd slot is never synthesized.
releaseGate.identity: Release is blocked if an asset disagrees with the locked current official Eagles-headshot appearance reference, current uniform number, approved realistic 3D chibi proportions, camera, lighting, scale or foot anchor.
releaseGate.alpha: Production frames require clean transparent alpha with no matte halo, clipped silhouette, stray pixels or opaque background.
releaseGate.signatures: Signature routing is allowlisted only for the four verified concepts already recorded in Philadelphia signature metadata, preserving celebration versus football-move classification.
releaseGate.fallback: A failed chibi release gate falls back to the existing non-chibi Gamecast presentation; it never blocks authoritative play data.

assetIntegrity.versionRule: Runtime references immutable versioned assets; replacement art increments version rather than mutating a consumed cache identity.
assetIntegrity.dimensions: Validate expected canvas dimensions and bottom-center foot-anchor coordinates before publishing.
assetIntegrity.decode: Validate successful browser decode and nonzero alpha bounds before an asset becomes preload-eligible.
assetIntegrity.football: Possession-bearing frames are checked against the single-football-authority rules from integration-04.
assetIntegrity.crossTeamGuard: Philadelphia manifests cannot resolve another team's player folder even if slugs or jersey numbers collide.
assetIntegrity.openSlotGuard: Roster index 53 without a roster.json identity produces no manifest key, probe, placeholder or fallback player art.

runtimeCanary.scope: Enable Philadelphia chibis independently from other NFL teams and independently from MLB/NHL presentation.
runtimeCanary.rollback: If identity, decode, animation ownership, football-authority or signature-classification invariants fail, disable only the Philadelphia chibi layer and retain existing Gamecast data/UI without clearing unrelated caches.
runtimeCanary.recovery: Re-enable only after a new manifest/version passes the same release gate; do not hot-patch a consumed immutable asset key.

identityGuards.appearanceAuthority: current official Eagles headshot lock; never infer skin tone or visible appearance from name
identityGuards.camera: shared Dallas-approved locked three-quarter Gamecast angle

checks: Roster inventory remains the sole action-eligibility authority and the legitimate open roster slot remains empty.
Identity, number, alpha, dimensions, decode and foot-anchor integrity are release gates.
Only verified Philadelphia signature concepts are allowlisted and their celebration/move classifications remain unchanged.
Runtime rollback removes only the Philadelphia chibi enhancement and preserves base Gamecast.
Immutable asset versions prevent stale cache identity from silently changing art.
No MLB/NHL runtime, cache or metadata dependency is introduced.
